page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch (Universitätsbibliothek Basel), not a printed page of the book. It carries the e-rara logo, the site description in four languages, the terms-of-use notice and the Visual Library logo, all left out as digitiser furniture. The sheet also gives the bibliographic data of the digitised book (Wolleb, Johannes, Disputationum theologicarum de SS. scriptura continuatio, Basileae, 1624), which is not transcribed because it is not printed text on this page. The scan contains no printed text of the book.
